provenance.method: exhaustion over all pairs of 3-qubit stabilizer states, via the quotient by the target

notes: Upgraded from reproduced to verified (exact: true, we* + @mizopl, 2026-11-10) via verify_challenge/cert_qubit_galois_m3_m4.py: for |T> = cos(beta)|0> + e^(i pi/4) sin(beta)|1> with cos(2 beta) = 1/sqrt(3), scaling by 2 / cos(beta) gives 2|0> + (1 + i)(sqrt(3) - 1)|1>, so (2 / cos(beta))^3 |T>^3 = (2|0> + (1 + i)(sqrt(3) - 1)|1>)^3 = A_3 + sqrt(3) B_3 with A_3, B_3 in Z[i]^8 (verified symbolically against stabrank_verify.target_vector). Across all 1,080 3-qubit stabilizer states, 0 states lie in P_3 = span_{Q(i)}(A_3, B_3) (m=2 rank-2 and m=3 rank-3 controls verified in the same run). Prior reproduced record (verify_challenge/cert_qubit_t_m3_rank2.py): Pairs with the annealed rank-3 decomposition to settle chi(|T>^3) = 3 exactly. The exclusion is numerical and rests on a margin: the closest any two key-adjacent quotient directions come to parallel is 0.81 against a threshold of 1 - 1e-6. The T-type state at m=2, whose rank-2 decomposition is verified on the board, is the positive control.
